description: Where Causa claims to implement each requirement of CAT-CAUSA-INVESTIGATION (kemiller2002/Indy-init requirements/catalogs/causa-investigation.requirement-catalog.json). Annotation only: the compiler never removes a requirement or an obligation because it is unmapped, and Dokimos checks that each mapped file actually carries the requirement's data-requirement-id. Unmapped, because Causa does not implement them: INV-007 (creation timestamp), INV-011 (hypothesis explanation), INV-012 (evidence original content). INV-003 does not apply (no domain profile can be selected).
